🎙
Russian President Vladimir Putin's
address
to participants and guests of
the International Sports Forum “Russia: Country of Sports”
(October 23, 2026)
💬
I am delighted to greet the participants and guests of
the
International Sports Forum “Russia: Country of Sports”
.
This year, it is taking place in
Krasnoyarsk
, a city famous for its long-standing and excellent sports traditions. It is here on the banks of the Yenisei River that
several generations of legendary athletes and Olympic champions
grew up.
People who engage in sports activities and practice sports develop a better sense of responsibility and discipline
. They are better than others when it comes to focusing on achieving their objectives. These qualities enable them to succeed in their personal lives, as well as when serving their people and their country. This explains why
the Forum’s agenda
attaches great importance to children’s and teenage sports and efforts to promote physical activities among young people.
This track takes on special significance in the context of
the main theme for this year’s Forum
, which reads
“Sport: Uniting the World in Times of Change”
. Eras and periods of this kind shape the future and create conditions in which states and their people can continue developing.
At the same time, we know that
any changes or transformations would be impossible without a solid foundation
, and sport has a lot to offer in this regard. I am primarily referring to core human values such as
equality, justice, mutual respect and the unifying power of sport
. An overwhelming majority of nations share these values.
❗️
Russia has always been and will remain an integral and important part of this family
, while reaffirming its commitment to strictly following all the international obligations and justified requirements it assumes.
We are open to dialogue and cooperation and stand for preserving sports traditions
, the fundamental norms of international sports law, while also focusing on advancing and promoting development.
We believe that the future of sport consists of making it as accessible as possible
, proactively introducing innovative technology in training and competition, as well as in sports medicine, athlete training programmes and education.
🤝
We welcome the emergence of new sports disciplines
. What matters most is that they enable people to develop themselves in harmony while promoting a healthy lifestyle at a social level.

item.title: ⚡️ Statement by Press Secretary of the Russian President Dmitry Peskov on the humanitarian operation in Alyoshki, Kherson Region
item.description: ⚡️ Statement by Press Secretary of the Russian President Dmitry Peskov on the humanitarian operation in Alyoshki, Kherson Region * (October 23, 2026) Russia welcomes the efforts of US First Lady Melania Trump , who has made a substantial contribution to securing agreement on a humanitarian operation in Alyoshki , Kherson Region. To implement the agreements reached by the Presidents of Russia and the US, Russian Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova and her Ukrainian counterpart have carried out extensive work with Ms Trump’s direct involvement. Representatives of the defence ministries are coordinating the timing of a ceasefire (from 04:00 Moscow time on October 27, 2026) to enable the humanitarian mission in Alyoshki. ❗️ Those wishing to leave the city will be able to do so. The mission requires extensive and complex preparations involving a wide range of representatives. Melania Trump is playing a coordinating role . This issue was discussed during the recent telephone conversation between Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump. *Unofficial translation

🎙
Interview
by Director of the Russian MFA North Atlantic Department
Alexander Gusarov
with
International Affairs magazine
(October 22, 2026)
Key points
:
•
The North Atlantic Department is considered one of
the Ministry’s
most distinguished and well-established departments
, with a history dating back to the 1920s. Its formal founding date, regarded as its birthday,
is October 1, 1925.
•
We regard regular consultations between the Russian and US leaderships, as well as through other working channels, as
an important stabilising force in bilateral relations and the entire international security architecture.
•
Restoring a constructive approach to
#RussiaUSA
relations does not automatically resolve all the problems and disagreements
that have accumulated between our countries over the years. Clearly,
a great deal of painstaking work still lies ahead.
•
We have no doubt that US President Donald Trump is sincere in seeking mutually acceptable terms for a lasting and sustainable political settlement.
We appreciate the efforts made by
him personally
and
by his representatives
.
•
The current Republican majority in both houses of Congress
did not prevent the adoption of the rather
damaging “Lindsey Graham Russia and Iran Sanctions Act
”.
•
There is no reason to expect positive changes in Russia-UK relations following the formation of a new government in London.
We are convinced that London has no interest in normalising relations.
•
Russia-Canada relations remain at a near-zero level.
This stems from the Canadian leadership’s irrational obsession with anti-Russian illusions and Ottawa’s commitment to supporting the neo-Nazi Kiev regime.
•
Canada’s history contains
many controversial chapters
involving
Nazi criminals and collaborators who settled in the country after 1945.
•
We remain open to restoring normal relations with Ireland
, despite its drift towards the anti-Russian consensus in Brussels and London.
Full interview
(in Russian)

item.title: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova Today, on October 23,
item.description: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova : 💬 Today, on October 23, we are working in Belarus , where several important humanitarian missions are taking place. 🫂 The long-awaited reunification of families took place: seven people are returning to Russia, and another seven to Ukraine. Each person has their own story . Some had long been unable to return to their loved ones because of problems with documents. Others found themselves far from their families, without support or means of subsistence. Among those who returned home today are elderly people , for whom being alone is especially difficult. Ahead lie reunions with relatives, the long-awaited embraces they have missed so much, and the chance to be close to their loved ones again. ❗️ In total, today’s humanitarian initiative reunited 12 families. This work was made possible by agreements with the Ukrainian side and the assistance of the International Committee of the Red Cross . When people’s lives are at stake, it is especially important to maintain dialogue and find solutions despite the difficulties . My thanks go to Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights Dmitry Lubinets . We continue our work, because behind every appeal to return home are people waiting for their loved ones. And every reunion brings immense joy.

🎙
Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Maria Zakharova's
response
to a media question during
her weekly press briefing
(October 21, 2026)
❓
Question: In his statements during the high-level week of
the 81st Session of the UN General Assembly
, Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov repeatedly emphasised that the world is beginning to forget the lessons of World War II. What dangers, in your view, does this pose?
💬
Maria Zakharova:
First, I would like to recall that the essential answer can be found in
Minister Lavrov’s statements at the
#UNGA81
, including
his address at the Security Council meeting on Ukraine
, which also provided a historical perspective, and
his press conference
.
I will give several examples
demonstrating that the threats he identified are anything but hypothetical.
☝️
I think many of you have heard of
the plan for
Operation Unthinkable
, initiated by British PM
Winston Churchill
in April 1945.
A surprise attack on Red Army positions was envisaged for June 1, 1945
, involving 47 British and American divisions
. The main objective was to drive Soviet troops out of Germany and Poland
, push them back to the borders of the USSR and, if circumstances permitted, beyond.
Victory over Nazism
had only just been declared on the European continent,
the war in the Far East
was still raging, and
these plans had already mapped out our fate
. Let us look at what these “schemes” entailed.
In September 1945, US President
Harry Truman
ordered the military to develop
an American equivalent of Britain’s Unthinkable plan – Totality
. Even then, American strategists were prepared to use
nuclear weapons
to contain the Red Army.
👉
Work on the next plan –
Operation Pincher
– was completed in March 1946. On March 5, 1946,
Winston Churchill
delivered his famous
Fulton speech
, widely regarded as
the public announcement of the Cold War
. Washington approved Pincher in June 1946.
The plan envisaged dropping between 20 and 30 atomic bombs on 20 Soviet cities.
And now they are going to lecture us about our country’s supposed imperial ambitions?
The very people who, even after World War II, were drawing up plans to literally wipe us out with nuclear weapons?
***
Throughout 1948, a succession of plans followed:
Bushwhacker, Crankshaft, Halfmoon, Fleetwood, Cogwheel, Offtackle
and
Charioteer
. Each new plan expanded the scale of the proposed nuclear strikes. Charioteer, for example, envisaged dropping
no fewer than 200 atomic bombs on 70 Soviet cities
.
On December 3, 1949, the US approved
the Trojan plan
, which provided for British participation in an attack on the USSR. The allies were preparing to drop
300 atomic bombs
and
20,000 conventional bombs
on
100 Soviet cities.
At the same time,
the Dropshot plan
was approved, envisaging an exclusively American operation. Under that plan,
300 atomic bombs
and
250,000 tonnes of conventional bombs
were to be dropped on the USSR.
Even after the US and the Soviet Union achieved nuclear parity,
the Americans continued to develop new plans similar to Totality and Dropsho
t.
5️⃣
plans were adopted in succession under President
Dwight Eisenhower
.
4️⃣
under
John F. Kennedy
.
4️⃣
under
Lyndon Johnson
.
5️⃣
under
Richard Nixon
.
Back in the 1940s and 1950s, however,
the US and British leadership
, despite all the efforts of the “hawks” in their ranks,
had enough common sense and political will to shelve these plans.
❗️
Unfortunately, people have now come to power in many EU capitals whose education, general cultural awareness and, frankly, mental make-up raise very serious questions
. These Western “elites” have neither the historical experience of the post-war generations nor the breadth of knowledge needed to understand the catastrophic consequences of their Russophobic policies, neo-Nazism and tolerance for the revival of the most horrific practices rooted in hatred of humanity –
from neo-Nazism and fascism to everything they spawn
.
This is precisely the danger Minister Lavrov warned of in his statements at
the UNGA81
.

🎙
Interview
with President of Russia Vladimir Putin by
Pavel Zarubin
(October 22, 2026)
Key points
:
•
The historical regions are not Ukrainian territory –
they are part of historical Russia
.
The people living in these territories first
voted for state independence
and, as a second step,
voted for reunification with the Russian Federation
. Any talk of Ukrainian “territorial losses” is inappropriate.
• The anti-Russian campaign
in European countries, the constant
talk of a Russian threat and of preparations for war
with our country constitute political schizophrenia.
❗️
Defeating Russia on the battlefield is impossible. Inflicting a strategic defeat on it is unrealistic.
•
Those who have sought Russia’s “strategic defeat” throughout the centuries – and, unfortunately, such people still exist today –
will recognise the realities of today’s world and understand that it is better to live in friendship with Russia.
This serves the interests of their peoples.
•
Looking at the political processes unfolding in Europe, it becomes clear that
the peoples of Europe do not want to go to war with Russia.
•
We do not want a war with Europe, nor are we preparing for one.
Yet, for some reason, the current Ukrainian leadership has decided that the whole world must pay it, fight on its behalf and supply weapons, ammunition, equipment and so on.
•
The Ukrainian leadership treats its citizens as expendable.
They are rounded up in the streets like stray dogs
and forcibly sent to the front
.
The official figures show
half a million deserters
and
more than 300,000 criminal cases
.
❗️
We have always advocated a peaceful resolution, from the very beginning.
In 2014, we offered to help Kiev reach an agreement with the southeast of what was then Ukraine.
Instead, artillery and aircraft were used against civilians, effectively unleashing a war
. Then
the Minsk agreements
were signed. We have always sought an agreement with the part of Ukraine that rejected
the violent 2014 coup
.
•
We remain ready to negotiate and seek solutions
to this difficult, complex situation, given that these people are very close to us.
Russians and Ukrainians are one people
. An agreement can be reached on everything.
In any event, we will accomplish our tasks, and all the goals of
the special military operation
will be achieved.
***
•
As for
our talks with the representative of the US administration
,
we agreed that we are ready to resume our trilateral contacts
(Russia/USA/Ukraine)
.
•
The purpose of
these talks
will be to discuss
security arrangements for Ukraine and Russia
once final peace agreements have been reached, rather than following a brief suspension of hostilities.
We are ready to resume these contacts to achieve this goal.
•
The representative of the US administration
pointed out
that if we discuss future security arrangements for both Ukraine and Russia,
we will naturally also need to address the European security architecture as a whole
.
☝️
I agree with this as well
. Let us see how the situation develops in the coming days.

item.title: 🎙 Statement by Deputy Head of the Delegation of the Russian Federation, Deputy Director of the Department for Non-Proliferation and Arms Control of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
item.description: 🎙 Statement by Deputy Head of the Delegation of the Russian Federation, Deputy Director of the Department for Non-Proliferation and Arms Control of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation Konstantin Vorontsov at the thematic discussion on "Outer Space (Disarmament Aspects)" in the First Committee of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly (New York, October 20, 2026) 💬 The Russian Federation consistently advocates for keeping outer space free of weapons of any kind and preventing it from turning into another area of an armed confrontation. The situation in space security is rapidly deteriorating . The risks of turning outer space into a springboard for aggression and war are becoming unprecedentedly high as a result of the implementation by the US and its allies of a destructive course to place weapons in orbit and use outer space for combat operations in order to ensure their global dominance and superiority. Original source: https://t.me/MFARussia/32905

🎙
Statement
by Deputy Head of the Delegation of the Russian Federation, Deputy Director of the Department for Non-Proliferation and Arms Control of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
Konstantin Vorontsov
at the thematic discussion on
"Outer Space (Disarmament Aspects)"
in the First Committee of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly
(New York, October 20, 2026)
💬
The Russian Federation consistently advocates for keeping outer space
free of weapons of any kind
and preventing it from turning into another area of an armed confrontation.
The situation in space security is
rapidly deteriorating
. The risks of turning outer space into a springboard for aggression and war are becoming unprecedentedly high as a result of
the implementation by the US and its allies of a destructive course to place weapons in orbit and use outer space for combat operations
in order to ensure their global dominance and superiority.
Recent statements by US Air Force Secretary T.Meink regarding the possession of “on-orbit weapons” and by Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman D.Kane about possible combat operations in “cislunar space” indicate that
Washington’s aggressive space-weapon ambitions
are moving into practical implementation. <...>
Another evidence of the aggressive character of Washington's space activities is
the “Golden Dome” project
, which involves the development of components of the global deeply layered and multi-domain missile defense system, including the orbital deployment of interceptors. <...>
There is no slowing down of the extremely dangerous trend when NATO countries use
space constellations
declared as systems for civilian (including commercial) purposes to support combat operations of foreign armed forces and to interfere in the internal affairs of sovereign states.
This in fact constitutes the indirect participation in armed conflicts
. <...>
❗️
We call upon delegations to give a proper assessment to the aggressive space-weapon ambitions of the US.
Only coordinated efforts by the international community can stop the disastrous arms race in outer space, which is approaching the point of no return due to Washington’s efforts.
The Russian Federation is convinced that a
t the current stage there is still an opportunity to prevent this negative scenario
. <...>
👉
We would like to recall our valid specific proposals
Without reliable guarantees to keep outer space free of weapons, enshrined in
an international legally-binding instrument on the prevention of an arms race in outer space
(
#PAROS
), it is pointless to address issues related to the peaceful uses of outer space and ensuring safety and security of outer space activities. <...>
The
international initiative/political commitment of No first placement of weapons in outer space
(
#NFP
) remains highly relevant in order to support the international peace, to ensure the equal and indivisible security for all, as well as to increase the predictability and sustainability of the activities of States in exploration and use of outer space for peaceful purposes. The number of full-fledged NFP participants
has reached 37
.
👉
We call on all UN Member States to support efforts to universalize this initiative and to undertake this political commitment.
***
The Russian Federation is hereby submitting draft UNGA resolutions
"No First Placement of Weapons in Outer Space"
and
"Further Practical Steps on PAROS"
, as well as draft UNGA decision
"Transparency and Confidence-Building Measures in Outer Space Activities"
for consideration by the First Committee.
In preparing these documents, we took into account best practices in the field of PAROS, as well as the outcomes of various specialized multilateral formats. These drafts are aimed at achieving the goal of PAROS and keeping outer space peaceful and free of weapons and conflicts for the benefit of future generations.
☝️
We are calling on all States to support our documents and cosponsor them.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/MFARussia/32904

🎙
Statement
by the Deputy Head of the Delegation of the Russian Federation, Deputy Director of the Department for Non-Proliferation and Arms Control of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation
Konstantin Vorontsov
at the thematic debate on Cluster
“Other types of WMDs”
in the First Committee of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly
(New York, October 19, 2026)
💬
We consider the
Convention
on the Prohibition of the Development, Production and Stockpiling of Bacteriological (Biological) and Toxin Weapons and on their Destruction (BTWC) as one of the pillars of the international security architecture
outlawed an entire category of weapons of mass destruction.
The Convention has
contributed significantly to the process of general and complete disarmament,
reducing the risks of the use of biological agents and toxins for military purposes.
☝️
The Russian Federation, as the Depositary State of the BTWC, has consistently implemented all its provisions in full.
However, we still cannot remove the problem of biological weapons from the international agenda. Some states continue military-biological activities against the provisions of the BTWC.
The legitimate questions officially raised by the Russian Federation with regard to the revealed facts about the military-biological program in Ukraine in violation of the BTWC with support of the Pentagon and its affiliates, including private companies,
remain unanswered.
The analysis of projects carried out in Ukrainian laboratories leads to the conclusion that biological weapons components were being and are being developed in close proximity to the Russian territory. We consider any such activity as a direct threat to our national security.
The admission by former US Director of National Intelligence
Ms. Tulsi Gabbard
of the facts of Washington’s long-term financing “risky” experiments with viruses at more than
120 foreign biolaboratories,
over 40 of which are located in Ukraine,
only confirms the validity of Russia’s claims regarding American military biological activity near our country. <...>
The Ukrainian case strongly confirms
the necessity of consolidated efforts of the international community to universalize and strengthen
the BTWC regime. We consider that the main priorities in this direction are the resumption of the work with a view to developing a universal,
legally binding and non-discriminatory protocol
that would cover all the BTWC articles and provide for an effective verification mechanism as well as strict implementation of the BTWC at the national level.
Russia intends to continue active efforts to strengthen the BTWC within the dedicated Working Group established by the decision of the Ninth Review Conference of the BTWC. We believe that only decisions taken by consensus can guarantee
reliable implementation of the BTWC
and prevent development and use of the biological weapons. <...>
The Russian Federation was one of the founding states of the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and Use of Chemical Weapons and on their Destruction (CWC) and, since its entry into force in 1997, has
consistently made efforts to comprehensively strengthen this effective international mechanism,
fully complying with its obligations.
At the same time,
a serious challenge to the effective implementation
of this multilateral treaty is the extreme politization of the activities of the relevant Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), which Western countries have effectively turned into a tool of political pressure and furthering of their geopolitical interests.
<...>
❗️
All of this
threatens to erode the chemical weapons non proliferation regime
and will ultimately lead to irreversible consequences, including the accelerated degradation of arms control and non-proliferation system as a whole.
Russian Federation, as responsible State Party to the CWC will continue to take
all possible measure
to prevent the de facto privatization of the OPCW by Western countries.
